lede: What Korean and global players run in Guild Conquest (길드 토벌전), taken from DCInside, the official Naver cafe and crumb.gg. Every claim links to the post it came from.
caveat: Snapshot of 2026-09-27; Season 5 closes 2026-09-28 12:00 KST, so its top scores can still move. The Season 5 leaders (2.3–3.2T) haven't published their teams. The decks here are the best documented ones. The top documented run is 1T 999G with the Cherry deck (score screenshot; crumb.gg lists it as 섬영, 판도라); its team power isn't shown anywhere, and the author's own ~650× puts it near 3G. The research record's STATE.md lists what's still open.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.

you.summary: Your screenshot (1G power, Cherry-deck lineup, Octo Wasabi 19★ / Hot Doggie 20★ / Candy Shade Pouch 11★) matches the meta deck cookie-for-cookie. The Lv.1 fillers are already right.
changes: Pomegranate: Lv.100 is fine. Dropping her to Lv.1 changes nothing but the displayed multiple.
Scorpion (the Lv.1 red fire cookie in row 2): try a few levels (Lv.10–45) so stray beams land on her rather than Dark Choco. Keep her ≥10% under your 6th cookie's ATK, checked in battle.
Candy Shade Pouch is at 11★ against 20★ in the top runs; it carries the lift resistance and HP.
Check the rune and gear tabs against your raid preset, especially Milk all ATK% and Brightseeker's total haste (target 40–50 in battle).
